question: What should we quote Northstar Retail for a managed-payroll setup for 120 employees in Belgium?

transcript.text: Hi, it's Alex from Northstar Retail. We're opening our Belgian subsidiary with 120 employees. What would SD Worx charge for the initial setup of managed payroll? We need an estimate today.
Let me check comparable projects and get back to you.

searchSteps: Reading CRM opportunities and signed quotes
Matching country, client and company size
groupsTitle: Search results — all fictional, one-time setup fees

groups.evidenceNote: Different retailer, 300 employees. Three documents from Maria.

extracts.title: Proposal — Hellas Market Group, managed payroll
extracts.excerpt: One-time implementation fee: €10,000, covering payroll setup, data migration from the legacy system and two integrations (time & attendance, ERP). Applies to 300 employees across 3 legal entities.

flags.text: 3.5 years old — based on the 2023 Greek price book

extracts.title: Hellas Market — kick-off meeting notes
extracts.excerpt: Client confirmed the €10k setup fee as agreed in the proposal. Go-live planned for July.

flags.text: Repeats the E1 figure, so it is not independent confirmation

extracts.title: Email: RE: Hellas pricing approval
extracts.excerpt: Approved: €10,000 setup, in line with GR price book 2023. Discount not applicable.

flags.text: Same quote as E1, from the same author

groups.evidenceNote: Similar retailer, 100 employees. Two proposals from Tom.
groups.assessment: Similar scale; different client and country

extracts.title: Proposal — Oranje Retail BV, payroll outsourcing

author.name: Tom de Vries
author.status: Active · out of office until 14 Oct

extracts.excerpt: Set-up fee €5,000 for 100 employees. Excludes data migration: the client supplies clean master data in the SD Worx template. One standard integration (HRIS export) included.

flags.text: Migration excluded, so likely lower than a full setup

extracts.title: Proposal — Oranje Retail BV (revision 2)

author.name: Tom de Vries
author.status: Active · out of office until 14 Oct

extracts.excerpt: Set-up fee unchanged at €5,000. Monthly per-payslip fee revised after negotiation.

flags.text: Revision of E4, so the setup figure is not independent

groups.evidenceNote: Northstar Retail, 120 employees. One proposal from Emma.
groups.assessment: Recent; same client and scale; different country

extracts.title: Proposal — Northstar Retail UK Ltd, managed payroll
extracts.excerpt: One-off setup fee £7,000 for 120 employees, including migration from Sage 50 and integration with Northstar's HRIS (Workday). UK statutory set-up only (RTI, pensions auto-enrolment).

flags.text: Same client group and same headcount
UK statutory scope; Belgian Dimona/DmfA and joint-committee setup not included
GBP pricing; not convertible 1:1 to a Belgian quote

signals.text: No Belgian managed-payroll setup quote was found in the 2026 Belgian price book index or in the Belgian CRM.
3 of 6 extracts repeat an earlier figure. They count as 3 independent sources, not 6.
The Greek quote (2023) predates the 2025 pricing model change.
Migration and integration scope differs across all three comparables.

answer.text: These projects provide useful comparisons, but none establishes a Belgian setup price. Their migration and integration scope may also differ. Repeated mentions of the same quote are not independent confirmation.
answer.indicative: Comparable one-time fees range from €5,000 to about €10,000. This is an indication, not a quote.

keyPoints.text: Closest match: the Northstar UK proposal (same client, 120 employees, 2026).
None of the sources is Belgian, so Belgian statutory setup (Dimona, DmfA, joint committee) is not priced anywhere.
Scope differs: NL excludes migration, while UK and GR include 1–2 integrations.
The Greek figure is 3.5 years old and based on a retired price book.

answer.gap: Confirm Belgian setup pricing and the migration/integration requirements for Northstar Retail.
